title: Add symmetry rule for read receipts
description: The spec has no rule requiring that if A opts out of sending read receipts, A also stops receiving them from others. Without this, opting out is asymmetric and creates a surveillance gap. Need a MUST in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md (Peer/receipt receiver behavior) and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (Chat/ReadPosition section) stating that a server MUST NOT deliver inbound Peer/receipt events to a client whose account has receipt sharing disabled.
close_reason: Added Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior (federation-00.md:310) with receiptSharing symmetry suppression; added bidirectional note to ReadPosition (chat-00.md:760)
